WITH overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(instownpct) as overall_mean
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
),
timing_avgs AS (
  SELECT eventannotm, AVG(instownpct) as timing_avg
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals
  WHERE instownpct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY eventannotm
),
above_average AS (
  SELECT timing_avg
  FROM timing_avgs
  WHERE timing_avg > (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_avg)
)
SELECT 
  AVG(timing_avg) as mean_of_timings_above_average,
  AVG(timing_avg) - (SELECT overall_mean FROM overall_avg) as difference_from_overall_average
FROM above_average
